stories.title: Validate Learning Outcome Distribution Compliance Across All CoCu Files
stories.description: Implement automated validation script that checks Knowledge (30%) vs Performance (70%) distribution for every work activity across all 20 CoCu files. Generate JSON compliance report with activity-level breakdown and overall score.
acceptanceCriteria: Script `scripts/validate_learning_outcomes.py` reads all content/IT-020-{3,4,5}/*.md files and parses Contact Hour Distribution sections
Generates logs/learning_outcomes_compliance_report.json with per-activity KO/PO percentages and overall compliance score (target ≥9.5/10)
Reports any work activity with non-compliant split (not 30/70) and suggests corrections

stories.title: Generate Formative Assessment Question Banks per CoCu Unit
stories.description: Create automation script that generates pools of formative assessment questions (knowledge + performance types) for each CoCu unit. Questions tied to specific learning outcomes with answer keys and difficulty levels.
acceptanceCriteria: Script `scripts/generate_formative_questions.py` templates knowledge questions (multiple choice, short answer) and performance questions (practical tasks, problem-solving)
Outputs content/IT-020-{3,4,5}/assessment/formative_questions_{unit_code}.json for each of 20 CoCu files
Each question references corresponding learning outcome ID and difficulty level (Foundation/Intermediate/Advanced)

stories.title: Create 4-Point Rubric Evaluation Scale for All Performance Assessment Tasks
stories.description: Implement script to generate structured assessment rubrics (Excellent/Proficient/Developing/Beginning) for performance-based learning outcomes. Each rubric includes specific observable criteria and point values.
acceptanceCriteria: Script `scripts/generate_assessment_rubrics.py` creates rubric templates tied to each work activity's performance outcomes
Rubric tables injected into Assessment Criteria section of each CoCu with 4-point scale and descriptors
Output: content/IT-020-{3,4,5}/assessment/performance_rubrics_{unit_code}.json with mapping to specific competencies

stories.title: Validate Bahasa Malaysia Terminology Consistency Across All Levels
stories.description: Create validation script that checks BM term usage is consistent across L3, L4, L5 CoCu files. Identifies variant spellings, terminology conflicts, and suggests standardization across the curriculum.
acceptanceCriteria: Script `scripts/validate_bm_terminology.py` extracts all BM terms from content/IT-020-{3,4,5}/*/*.md and compares usage across levels
Generates logs/bm_terminology_inconsistencies.json listing terms with variant spellings and cross-file usage patterns
Reports ≥95% consistency score; flags terms appearing in only one level or with multiple BM translations

stories.title: Generate Cross-Level Learning Outcome Progression Validation Report
stories.description: Implement script that validates learning outcome progression from L3 (foundational) → L4 (intermediate) → L5 (advanced/management). Ensures competencies build logically across qualification levels with HTML dashboard visualization.
acceptanceCriteria: Script `scripts/validate_level_progression.py` compares learning outcomes across corresponding units in all three levels
Generates HTML dashboard at output/learning_outcome_progression_dashboard.html showing progression matrix with color-coded alignment
Reports any L4/L5 outcomes that don't build on L3 foundation; flags gaps in competency progression

stories.title: Auto-Generate Technical Glossary from All Key Terms Tables
stories.description: Create script that extracts technical terms from all 20 CoCu Key Terms tables, deduplicates, and generates unified bilingual glossary. Glossary injected into final DOCX documents.
acceptanceCriteria: Script `scripts/generate_technical_glossary.py` parses all Key Terms tables and creates content/glossary/NOSS-IT-020-Technical-Glossary.md with English+BM definitions
Updated generate_docx.py inserts glossary as appendix in output .docx with proper formatting and index
Glossary is cross-referenced from first mention of each term in main content

stories.title: Implement Sequential Auto-Numbering for Work Activities and Learning Outcomes
stories.description: Develop script that applies consistent sequential numbering to all work activities (WA-L3-001, WA-L4-001, etc.) and learning outcomes (LO-L3-001, LO-L4-001, etc.) across all content files.
acceptanceCriteria: Script `scripts/auto_number_activities.py` reads all markdown files and applies hierarchical numbering: WA-{Level}-{3-digit sequence} for Work Activities, LO-{Level}-{3-digit sequence} for Learning Outcomes
Updates all internal references and maintains cross-file consistency (no duplicates within level)
Verification: logs/numbering_report.json confirms all 20 files numbered, no gaps, no duplicates

stories.title: Validate Equipment and Tools Currency Against 2024-2025 Industry Standards
stories.description: Create validation script that checks tools and equipment listed in all CoCu files against current industry availability, manufacturer support status, and relevance for Malaysian IT training context.
acceptanceCriteria: Script `scripts/validate_equipment_currency.py` reads Tools/Equipment tables from all 20 CoCu files and cross-references against maintained reference list of current industry standards
Generates logs/equipment_currency_report.json with status (Current/Aging/Obsolete) for each tool; suggests modern alternatives where relevant
Flags any equipment marked Obsolete; achieves ≥95% currency score across curriculum

stories.title: Generate Interactive NOSS Compliance Dashboard with Comprehensive Scoring Metrics
stories.description: Implement script that generates HTML dashboard showing real-time NOSS compliance status across all 20 CoCu files. Includes section completeness, learning outcome distribution accuracy, contact hour validation, and bilingual coverage metrics.
acceptanceCriteria: Script `scripts/generate_compliance_dashboard.py` produces output/noss_compliance_dashboard.html with interactive tables and visual indicators
Dashboard tracks: section completeness (8/8 required), LO distribution (30/70 split), contact hours (target per level), bilingual coverage (100%), and overall compliance score
Color-coded status (✓ Compliant / ⚠ Warning / ✗ Non-compliant); links to specific file/section for remediation

stories.title: Create Evidence Collection Checklists for Competency-Based Assessment per Unit
stories.description: Generate evidence checklist templates for each CoCu work activity that map to specific learning outcomes. Checklists guide assessors on observable evidence types and acceptance criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: Script `scripts/generate_evidence_checklists.py` creates content/IT-020-{3,4,5}/assessment/evidence_checklist_{unit_code}.md for all 20 CoCu files
Each checklist tied to work activities with observable evidence types (observation, test, product, questioning) and links to corresponding performance rubric
Checklists formatted as markdown tables for easy printing; included in assessment section of generated DOCX files
